retained_global_ship_blocking_holds.description: Visual recognition practice requires source-image validation of complex signal combinations, image-dependent sign mappings and flagger poses.
Rail crossing, lane and interchange illustrations were not visually checked in this text-only pass. Any image-dependent recognition exercise requires source-image validation.
Hill-parking and maneuver illustrations were not visually checked. Textual wheel-direction rules are supported, but image-dependent practice needs source-image validation.

The pedestrian subsection adds a divided-highway qualifier to the school-bus exception, while the earlier detailed bus section states the lane-count exception without that word. Issuer clarification is needed before teaching a unified exception.
Bike-box, shared-lane and truck No-Zone diagrams have not been visually validated. Image-based identification or position questions need source-image review.

The child-seat legal list joins age and weight with AND, and its later belt and front-seat clauses include manufacturer limits and unreproduced statutory exceptions. Exact threshold logic and current applicability require legal review before instructional rules are minted.

The traffic-stop rights passage makes broad claims about information duties, passenger compliance, searches, detention duration and access to counsel. These legal claims are withheld pending qualified review and current statutory verification.
Seat, restraint and steering illustrations have not been visually checked. Image-dependent fit, position or maneuver practice needs source-image validation.
ABS and blind-spot illustrations were not visually checked. Any diagram-dependent practice requires source-image validation.

The same page pairs an approximate reaction-and-stop distance with a shorter headlight distance at roughly the same speed. The headlight-speed pairing is withheld pending issuer clarification and must not be taught as a guaranteed safe speed.

The merge passage says splitting a four-second gap produces three-second following gaps on both sides. That arithmetic is inconsistent; the fixed merge-gap explanation is withheld pending issuer correction and must not be used to certify a safe gap.

The side-space continuation says not to share a lane with a cyclist, while the earlier detailed bicycle rule permits in-lane passing in unusually wide lanes under stated conditions. The unqualified prohibition is withheld until its scope is reconciled.

The health subsection gives broad statements about epilepsy, insulin-treated diabetes, cardiovascular conditions and loss-of-consciousness certification. Diagnosis-specific advice and the certification scope are withheld pending qualified clinical/legal review.

The fatigue list says not to take drowsiness-causing medicine without distinguishing prescribed treatment or clinical supervision. Do not turn this into an instruction to stop or change medication; qualified review is needed.

The shoulder-return passage tells the driver to turn sharply after listed preconditions without describing edge drop, surface or vehicle constraints. That steering instruction is withheld pending technical safety review.

The fire and crash passages describe self-extinguishing methods, a fixed separation distance and use of flares despite possible spilled fuel. These operational details are withheld pending current fire-safety guidance and site/equipment conditions.

The stalled-track text suggests a restart attempt when no train is seen, but does not specify a full evacuation, emergency-notification or safe-restart procedure. The restart instruction is withheld pending applicable official rail-safety verification.

The generic skid-recovery passage does not distinguish skid type or ABS equipment and gives a blanket brake prohibition and repeated steering corrections. Those detailed recovery instructions are withheld pending technical review.

The impact-protection passage states that an airbag will inflate and gives collision-steering/bracing advice without deployment or crash-condition limits. These guarantees and specific impact maneuvers are withheld pending equipment and safety review.

The first-aid passage says not to move injured people except for specified immediate dangers, while a later aid duty includes transporting them for care. Medical handling, bleeding and shock directions are withheld pending qualified clinical/legal reconciliation.
